messages:
Morgan Liu: @channel Heads-up — we're cutting over to SSH certificate-based access for internal repo and bastion logins (Vault PKI + SSO). Goal: remove long-lived deploy keys and use short-lived certs issued via our Vault integration with SSO. Cutover window: Thu 2026-04-01 02:00-03:00 UTC. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ssh-cert-cutover. Please read & test before the window.

Priya Nair: Will this affect CI runners? What changes do we need in .github/workflows or self-hosted runners?

Evan Chen: CI runners will switch to ephemeral certs minted by our vault-agent. We've added a helper script (vault-ssh-helper.sh) and a GHA step template. Example runner config:

```
# /etc/ssh/vault-agent.conf
role = "ci-runner"
ttl = "30m"
```

And in the job you can do:

```
- name: Generate SSH key
  run: |
    ssh-keygen -f /tmp/ci_key -N ''
- name: Mint cert from Vault
  env:
    VAULT_ADDR: ${{ secrets.VAULT_ADDR }}
  run: |
    vault write -field=signed_key ssh/sign/ci role=ci-runner public_key=@/tmp/ci_key.pub > /tmp/ci_key-cert.pub
- name: Use cert
  run: |
    eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"
    ssh-add /tmp/ci_key
```

Evan Chen: We'll open a GH repo with the action template and a migration guide.

Samir Patel: For local dev, quick steps to request a cert:

```
ssh-keygen -f ~/.ssh/id_redwood
vault write ssh/sign/dev role=developer public_key=@~/.ssh/id_redwood.pub ttl=1h > ~/.ssh/id_redwood-cert.pub
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_redwood -o CertificateFile=~/.ssh/id_redwood-cert.pub git@github.com
```

Also add a Host github.com entry in ~/.ssh/config to pick the cert automatically.

infra-bot: Reminder: all old deploy keys will be revoked at cutover time. See https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ssh-cert-cutover for the revocation schedule.

Priya Nair: Thanks — i'll add a job to our CI template to generate the key and call Vault. Tagging @Evan Chen for a quick review.

Morgan Liu: Quick verification checklist for teams: 1) Create a test cert locally; 2) Open a PR updating your service/runner to the cert flow; 3) Post 'verified' in this thread. If you have automated jobs that currently use persistent SSH keys, please file an incident ticket or ping ops so we can approve an exception.

Evan Chen: We added a 24-hour compatibility fallback: old keys will still allow pushes for a day after cutover but won't grant admin operations. This should smooth the staged rollout.

Samir Patel: Verified — local cert minting and git push worked for me. No extra perms required. :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: FYI i'll rotate the KMS key used to sign certs tomorrow morning to test key rotation. Expect short-lived failures if your agent caches cert metadata — restart agent if you see sign errors.

deploy-bot: [deploy] vault/pki rotated signer key 1792300500 — new signer active

Morgan Liu: Thanks everyone. If you hit issues after cutover please ping #eng-oncall or escalate to Priya/Evan. Final reminder: read the runbook and test before Thu.
